name: Muse
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Muse is a Discord music bot that plays from YouTube and Spotify links, with FFmpeg and yt-dlp included. It needs a Discord bot token and a YouTube API key.
startup: export TERM=dumb PATH="/home/container/bin:$PATH" YT_DLP_PATH=/home/container/bin/yt-dlp YARN_CACHE_FOLDER=/home/container/.cache/yarn; h=$( (node --version; cat package.json yarn.lock) | sha256sum | cut -d" " -f1); if [ "$h" != "$(cat node_modules/.raptor-installed 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo "Installing Muse's dependencies"; { yarn install --frozen-lockfile --non-interactive --silent --ignore-scripts && yarn --silent patch-package >/dev/null && yarn --silent prisma generate >/dev/null && echo "$h" > node_modules/.raptor-installed; } || exit 1; yarn cache clean --silent >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; if [ -z "$DISCORD_TOKEN" ] || [ -z "$YOUTUBE_API_KEY" ]; then echo "Muse needs a Discord bot token and a YouTube API key: set them in Startup, then restart the server."; exec sleep infinity; fi; exec node_modules/.bin/tsx src/scripts/migrate-and-start.ts

config.startup: {"done": ["Ready! Invite the bot with", "Muse needs a Discord bot token"]}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Muse: downloads the chosen release from GitHub, with the FFmpeg and yt-dlp
# it plays music with (both checked against their checksums). The data
# folder (settings, cache) and .env are never touched. Its dependencies are
# installed when the server starts, for the Node.js version it runs.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
# Downloads unpack in a folder in the server's (the install's /tmp is
# small), removed when the script ends.
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
rm -rf .raptor-new
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
    aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
    *) fail "This server's CPU ($(uname -m)) isn't supported." ;;
esac
download() {
    curl -fsSL -o "$2.part" "$1" || { rm -f "$2.part"; fail "The download failed ($1). Reinstall to try again."; }
    if [ -n "${3:-}" ] && [ "$(sha256sum "$2.part" | cut -d' ' -f1)" != "$3" ]; then
        rm -f "$2.part"; fail "The download didn't match its checksum. Reinstall to try again."
    fi
    mv -f "$2.part" "$2"
}
put_release() {
    local new=$1 e; shift
    local keep=" $* "
    if [ -f .raptor-files ]; then
        while IFS= read -r e; do
            if [ -n "$e" ] && [ ! -e "$new/$e" ] && [ "${keep#* "$e" }" = "$keep" ]; then rm -rf -- "./$e"; fi
        done < .raptor-files
    fi
    : > .raptor-files.new
    while IFS= read -r e; do
        if [ "${keep#* "$e" }" != "$keep" ] && [ -e "./$e" ]; then
            if [ -d "$new/$e" ]; then cp -rn "$new/$e/." "./$e/" || true; fi
        else
            rm -rf -- "./$e"
            mv "$new/$e" "./$e"
        fi
        echo "$e" >> .raptor-files.new
    done < <(find "$new" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -printf '%f\n')
    mv -f .raptor-files.new .raptor-files
    rm -rf "$new"
}

want="${VERSION:-latest}"
tag=latest
if [ "$want" != latest ]; then tag="v${want#v}"; fi
tag=$(gh-release tag museofficial/muse "$tag") || fail "Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 2.12.0, then reinstall."
version="${tag#v}"

if [ -f package.json ] && [ "$(jq -r .version package.json)" = "$version" ] && [ -d src ]; then
    echo "Muse $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Muse $version"
    download "https://github.com/museofficial/muse/archive/refs/tags/$tag.tar.gz" $work/muse.tar.gz
    mkdir .raptor-new
    tar -xzf $work/muse.tar.gz -C .raptor-new --strip-components=1
    rm -rf $work/muse.tar.gz .raptor-new/.github .raptor-new/Dockerfile .raptor-new/.dockerignore
    put_release .raptor-new data
fi
mkdir -p bin data

# FFmpeg: the newest release build for Linux.
ff=https://github.com/FFmpeg-Builds/FFmpeg-Builds/releases/download/latest
case "$arch" in amd64) ffa=linux64 ;; arm64) ffa=linuxarm64 ;; esac
sums=$(curl -fsSL "$ff/checksums.sha256") || fail "FFmpeg's builds can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
line=$(grep -E "  ffmpeg-n[0-9.]+-latest-$ffa-gpl-[0-9.]+\.tar\.xz$" <<<"$sums" | sort -V -k2 | tail -n1)
[ -n "$line" ] || fail "There's no FFmpeg build for this CPU ($arch) right now. Reinstall to try again later."
ffsum="${line%% *}"; ffname="${line##* }"
if [ -x bin/ffmpeg ] && [ "$(cat bin/.ffmpeg 2>/dev/null)" = "$ffsum" ]; then
    echo "FFmpeg is up to date."
else
    echo "Downloading FFmpeg (${ffname%.tar.xz})"
    download "$ff/$ffname" $work/ffmpeg.tar.xz "$ffsum"
    mkdir $work/ffmpeg
    tar -xJf $work/ffmpeg.tar.xz -C $work/ffmpeg --strip-components=2 --wildcards '*/bin/ffmpeg' '*/bin/ffprobe'
    mv -f $work/ffmpeg/ffmpeg $work/ffmpeg/ffprobe bin/
    echo "$ffsum" > bin/.ffmpeg
    rm -rf $work/ffmpeg $work/ffmpeg.tar.xz
fi

# yt-dlp: the newest release.
case "$arch" in amd64) yta=yt-dlp_linux ;; arm64) yta=yt-dlp_linux_aarch64 ;; esac
yt=https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/latest/download
ytsum=$(curl -fsSL "$yt/SHA2-256SUMS" | awk -v n="$yta" '$2 == n { print $1 }') || true
[ -n "$ytsum" ] || fail "yt-dlp's releases can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
if [ -x bin/yt-dlp ] && [ "$(sha256sum bin/yt-dlp | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$ytsum" ]; then
    echo "yt-dlp is up to date."
else
    echo "Downloading yt-dlp"
    download "$yt/$yta" bin/yt-dlp "$ytsum"
    chmod +x bin/yt-dlp
fi
echo "Installed Muse $version."

variables.name: Discord bot token
variables.description: The bot's token, from the Discord Developer Portal.

variables.name: YouTube API key
variables.description: A YouTube Data API v3 key, from the Google Cloud console.

variables.name: Spotify client ID
variables.description: A Spotify app's client ID, to play Spotify links. Optional.

variables.name: Cache size
variables.description: How much disk the song cache may use, such as 2GB or 500MB.

variables.name: Update yt-dlp at start
variables.description: Update yt-dlp when the bot starts, since YouTube changes often.

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Muse version to install, such as 2.12.0, or latest. Reinstall to change it.
